observed_corrections.observation: The original prompt allowed semantic content to invert incoming and outgoing speaker identity in the WhatsApp fixture.
observed_corrections.control: Prompt v5 requires visual_direction and the parser derives speaker identity from visual direction plus the declared screenshot owner; recruiter-backed candidate assertions are discarded.
observed_corrections.retest: Both order-varied WhatsApp runs scored 100 with no assertions and no_action.

observed_corrections.observation: Long Chinese OCR spans can vary by one or two glyphs while remaining visibly tied to the same message.
observed_corrections.control: The benchmark permits a bounded approximate match only for reference strings of at least 12 normalized characters and reports every use as a quality warning.
observed_corrections.retest: Both WeChat runs retained correct speakers, ambiguity, and no unsafe action.

observed_corrections.observation: The Xiaohongshu-style synthetic image contains no platform name or logo, so one repeated run honestly returned unknown.
observed_corrections.control: The reference accepts xiaohongshu or unknown for that fixture instead of inferring platform from color alone.
observed_corrections.retest: The full 10-case benchmark was rerun after the evidence-boundary correction and passed 136/136.

observed_corrections.observation: A preliminary stability run recorded two first-attempt provider timeouts.
observed_corrections.control: Production remains fail-closed at 45 seconds. The benchmark records and bounds one test-only retry so later cases still execute.
observed_corrections.retest: The final full run required no retry; no timeout path persisted a capture or external action.

privacy_and_authority.fixtures: Synthetic only; no real candidate conversation is included.

limits: The 100 score is an atomic result for this curated synthetic corpus, not an overall product score, field accuracy claim, or human-user study.
Independent human annotation, inter-rater agreement, larger theme and language coverage, drift monitoring, and authorized real-world cases remain future evidence.
Provider-side retention and backup behavior are not independently verified by this local runtime proof.
